name: t1.1-greenspace
title: Greenspace exposure inequality, Global North vs Global South

sources.title: Chen et al., Contrasting inequality in human exposure to greenspace between cities of Global North and Global South, Nature Communications 13:4636 (2022)
Chen, City-scale greenspace exposure and inequality, HKU DataHub

moveq.original: Greenspace exposure inequality in Global South cities (Gini 0.47) is nearly twice that of Global North cities (Gini 0.24–0.27).
moveq.moveq_question: Do per-city Gini values deposited with the paper match moveq's Lorenz-trapezoid Gini within a stated tolerance?
limitations: The city-level extract is not in this repository. The deposit is CC BY-NC 4.0, which cannot be redistributed under moveq's BSD-3-Clause licence.
The paper is CC-BY-4.0 and reports regional means, not the per-city table needed to recompute those means.
HTTP 403 on the DataHub project page is a retrieval inconvenience; the licence, not the 403, is why the extract is absent.
Promotion to REPRODUCED requires a committable extract under a redistribution-compatible licence, plus a CI check against oracles.py — not against concentrationMetrics.
